title: TEDxTokyo — 日本の教育を変える (Reimagining Japanese Education)
description: A TEDxTokyo talk in Japanese on reforming the Japanese education system. The speaker discusses the tension between rote learning (詰め込み教育) and developing critical thinking, the role of 受験 exam culture, and emerging alternative schools and approaches to education. N3 formal spoken Japanese.
